entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4658354927055221632 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/ogle-lmc-ecl-10567-a/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv. Distance: Pietrzynski et al. (2019), Nature 567, 200, Table 1: distance modulus 18.455 +/- 0.014 for OGLE-LMC-ECL-10567, converted here as 10^(1 + m/5) pc (https://arxiv.org/abs/1903.08096): 49091 +/- 317 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.6764 +/- 0.1417 mas (same row, RUWE 4.50), 4.8 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 3.225, -1.852 mas/yr. Radial velocity: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 4658354927055221632 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 20,000,000 of its distance per century (https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia%20DR3%204658354927055221632).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,070 K and log g 2.179 (u1 0.603, u2 0.164): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
